Is more money passed down as sub-grants or as sub-contracts?
SELECT subaward_type, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in ChEMBL are in phase 3 clinical trials?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 3
Which ZIP codes in New York City complain to the FCC the most?
SELECT zip, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'NY' AND city = 'New York' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many census tracts are home to more than 5,000 voting-age citizens?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_elections.cvap_tract WHERE lntitle = 'Total' AND try_cast(cvap_est AS double) > 5000
Which states recorded the most births in 2024?
SELECT stname, try_cast(births2024 AS double) AS births FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many reactions in granted patents report a yield of 100%?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE textminedyield = '100%'
Which states had the largest total personal income in 2024?

SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS income_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geofips LIKE '%000' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many independents serve in state legislatures across the country?
SELECT count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE party = 'I'
Which chemical systems have the most computed materials?
SELECT chemsys, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the most candidates for the U.S. House in 2022?
SELECT cand_office_st, count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'H' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Service Contract Act wage determinations are active today?
SELECT count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' AND is_active = 'Y'
Why do judges leave their posts, and how often for each reason?
SELECT termination_reason, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE coalesce(termination_reason, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
